About.title: About Me
About.subtitle: Let Me Introduce Myself
About.description: I’m Ahmed Tawheed, a specialized UI/UX Designer with 3+ years of experience in crafting intuitive digital experiences. I bridge the gap between complex functionality and aesthetic elegance, focusing on user-centered design, wireframing, and interactive prototyping using Figma and Adobe Suite.

Works.title: My Work
Works.subtitle: Featured Projects
Works.description: Selected works that showcase my skills and passion for creating intuitive user experiences and aesthetic digital solutions.

p1.title: The Curated Frame
p1.desc: A minimalist e-commerce component study focusing on 'No-Line Philosophy'. It solves visual clutter by using tonal shifts and elevation to define product states (Normal, Hover, Disabled) ensuring a seamless shopping flow.

p2.title: PayFast Mobile Wallet
p2.desc: A fintech simulation addressing the complexity of digital payments. Designed a frictionless onboarding process including secure email verification and a streamlined dashboard for quick financial transactions.

p3.title: School of Agriculture
p3.desc: An educational agricultural platform designed to bridge the gap between farmers and experts. Solves information accessibility through a curated article system and a scalable roadmap for expert consultations.

p4.title: AgriCode Ecosystem
p4.desc: A multi-service Agritech platform solving the fragmentation of farming tools. Integrated AI diagnostics, IoT marketplace, and waste management into one cohesive UI, streamlining the farm-to-market journey.

p5.title: KITAPY App
p5.desc: A modern bookstore experience designed for bibliophiles. Solves the 'search fatigue' problem with an advanced filtering system and a clean, typography-focused UI that enhances the browsing experience.

p6.title: MediStream Dashboard
p6.desc: A comprehensive SAAS dashboard for clinics. It solves administrative overhead by visualizing patient queues, financial analytics, and debt tracking, allowing doctors to focus on healthcare over paperwork.

p7.title: cleaner App
p7.desc: A service booking platform designed for the cleaning industry. It addresses the challenge of scheduling and service discovery by providing an intuitive interface for users to book, manage, and review cleaning services efficiently.
